title: Scam & Fraud Recognition
description: Spot phishing, fake calls, AI voice cloning, and financial scams before they cost you money — the red flags that actually work, memorized for life.

changelog.notes: Initial release — 26 decks, 130 cards, covering scam psychology, phishing, AI voice cloning, financial fraud, and social-engineering scams, each pack with a preview card before its graded main card and practice cards.
Rewrote 1 preview true/false card(s) whose answer was false, so every preview statement is true.
Added 11 review cards, a deck image, the glossary terms QR, AI, URL, PIN and SMS, and description links for the scam terms.
